Spot the error in 5 seconds ⏱

"Neither the teacher nor the students was ready for the surprise test."

Which part is wrong? Comment A, B, C or D before the answer shows 👇

#VerbalAbility #IPMAT #IPMAT2027 #EnglishGrammar #IPMCareers
answer: C: "was ready" should be "were ready" (with neither...nor, the verb agrees with the closer subject, "students", which is plural)
